name: luchorpán
text: luchorpán is a MacKillop earlier spelling of leprechaun. MacKillop records the form as one of several older dialect spellings of the same folkloric being. The full record of the leprechaun tradition in Celtic folklore sits under the headword leprechaun.

attributes.attribute: Earlier spelling of leprechaun; pointer to leprechaun headword

okr.objective: luchorpán is a MacKillop variant-signpost for the leprechaun headword.
key_results: Signpost cites leprechaun as the canonical headword.
